title: GenAIPreProdReview
description: Pre-production gate review for a GenAI use case before initial release or material expansion. Rolls up upstream artifacts (intake, tier, model card, validation plan results, prompt-injection review, RAG evaluation, vendor evidence review where applicable) and produces a recommended decision with conditions, named gates, owners, and source trace. Consumed by the AI risk committee, the AI Governance Lead, MRMO, the model owner, and a regulator response file when one is built.

gate_id.description: Canonical gate ID for this review.

reviewer_role.description: Function consolidating the review (typically AI Governance Lead or AI risk committee secretary).

architecture_summary.description: One-paragraph summary; pointer to the model card system description is preferable.

rationale.description: One paragraph, regulator-readable, naming the conditions that drove the call.

blocking_vs_tracking.description: Explicit identification of which open conditions are blocking and which are tracking. Required when decision is go_with_conditions.

upstream_artifacts.description: Roll-up of upstream artifacts the gate review depends on. Any artifact stale or missing should be reflected in the recommended decision.

link.description: Pointer to the artifact (record ID, file path, system reference, or [evidence needed]).

open_conditions.description: Conditions that must close before go (blocking) or that track to a defined date (tracking). Empty array is allowed for go decisions.

sla.description: Date or milestone (e.g., pre-prod gate, go-live + 30 days).

blocking.description: True if condition blocks go-live; false if tracking only.

residual_risk.description: Top residual risks, typically three to five for a tier-2 use case and more for tier-1. Each entry requires likelihood, impact, and accepted owner role.

basis.description: One-line basis for the rating; cross-reference to upstream artifact where possible.

monitoring_readiness.description: Production signals and detection capabilities live before go-live. Each entry requires owner and escalation path.

drill_scope.description: Which incident classes the most recent drill exercised.

regulator_notification_triggers.description: Named notification regimes evaluated for this use case (e.g., NYDFS Part 500 §500.17(a), SEC 8-K Item 1.05, GLBA Safeguards Rule, state breach laws, sector-specific notifications). Per the loaded overlays.

off_switch_documented.description: Whether the operational off-switch criteria are documented and exercised.

decision_points.description: Named human-in-the-loop or human-on-the-loop decision points and the role accountable.

sampling_expectation.description: Sampling cadence and scope for output review or override audit.

effective_oversight_evidence.description: Evidence the oversight is operative and not nominal (training, sampling results, override-rate baseline).

off_switch_criterion.description: When the human oversight is judged ineffective and the system pauses; e.g., agent-edit rate falling below threshold for two periods.

swap_revalidation_policy.description: Documented policy for re-validation on vendor change-of-version notice; required when dependency_present is true.

vendor_evidence_review_id.description: Links to the llm-vendor-evidence-review record where applicable.

overlay_signoffs.description: Sign-off status for each loaded sector overlay and cross-cutting overlay.

signoff.description: Named sign-off block. Reviewer roles, never named individuals. A single-name sign-off block is itself a finding.

function.description: AI governance, model risk, cyber, compliance, privacy, consumer compliance, BSA, legal, etc.

basis.description: One-line basis for the position; required for dissent.

source.description: Document, system, person, vendor evidence, upstream artifact ID, or [evidence needed].

sector_overlay_notes.description: Sector-specific fields raised by the loaded sector overlay reference doc.

cross_cutting_overlay_notes.description: Cross-cutting fields raised by the loaded cross-cutting overlay reference doc.
